4e07527e1b3741c6942acceb9acca94a.overview: Four sisters come of age in America in the aftermath of the Civil War.

4e29a3488a448fd89b90e77febeb2981.overview: The story, set in Kansas during the 1920's, covers less than a year in the life of a black teenager, and documents the veritable deluge of events which force him into sudden manhood. The family relationships and enmities, the fears, frustrations and ambitions of the black teenager in small-town America are explored with a strong statement about human values.

4e3528c7495c9e18f731ff42ec13b8a7.overview: An elderly artist thinks he has become too stale and is past his prime. His friend (and agent) persuades him to go to an offshore island to try once more. On the island he re-discovers his muse in the form of a young girl.

4eec9e8c5a45a6f70bc0add208dfeace.overview: When oil is discovered in 1920s Oklahoma under Osage Nation land, the Osage people are murdered one by one—until the FBI steps in to unravel the mystery.
4eec9e8c5a45a6f70bc0add208dfeace.tagline: Can you find the wolves in this picture?

4eed397e32c0a3ed6a035c07abba0296.overview: The life of Al Roberts, a pianist in a New York nightclub, turns into a nightmare when he decides to hitchhike to Los Angeles to visit his girlfriend.
4eed397e32c0a3ed6a035c07abba0296.tagline: He went searching for love… but fate forced a DETOUR to revelry… violence… mystery!
